body: The Phase Map shows released and sealed encounter units in relation.
Open nodes may be entered directly.
Sealed nodes remain visible as part of the installation but require Connect before access.
Edges show progression, threshold, and axis relation.
explanation.title: How to read the Phase Map

next_release.body: Held chamberplates remain sealed until the next seated release window.

description: The exhibition is complete, but released by ritual and presented in order of release.
This map shows what is currently viewable.
Your progress is saved as you move.
You may return to gates, epithets, and MEs you have already encountered.
